findings: 1. Ad creative snapshot — 0 active SWH ads live (Sep 14). Library shows electric geyser creatives (Omnis Wi-Fi Voice, Pronto Dark 5L ₹8,199) — solar heater creatives are not running as lead ads, despite 100–500 LPD range and 5yr warranty that could hook "Cut geyser bill 70%" — so the 35 WhatsApp-gap in CSV is actually an electric-led catalog, not a paid solar funnel.
Why it matters: running geyser ads without a solar cross-sell retargeting step misses the highest-margin upsell in winter.

2. Landing page — solar is a catalog tile on a geyser homepage. Fetch shows 3 geyser tiles (Electric Storage + Instant + Heat Pump) + Racold Advantages (60yr, Ariston) before "Solar Water Heaters" — /alpha-plus lists tubes/anode/PUF specs but there is no "100 LPD ₹28k vs geyser ₹/yr = payback 2.5yr" hero or 1-click WhatsApp quote.
Why it matters: cold "solar water heater price" intent lands on electric geysers — mismatch drops CVR 30–45%.

3. Tracking — likely firing for geysers, not segmented for SWH. Enterprise site likely has GA4/GTM but fetched SWH pages show no dedicated SWH Lead event (ViewAlphaPlus / StartSWHQuote) — SWH visitors blend into geyser traffic.
Why it matters: you cannot build a SWH-only retargeting pool ("saw Alpha Plus 200L but not started quote") for winter nurture.

4. Form friction — "Enquire Now" generic vs instant SWH matcher. SWH CTA → generic Enquire form or SolarClue price → external checkout before showing "Family size → LPD + roof space + subsidy/Mahindra? + EMI" preview.
Why it matters: flipping to "Family of 4 → 200 LPD + 8x9 ft roof + ₹/mo EMI preview → then gate" lifts SWH leads.

5. Niche-specific — solar vs heat-pump bundling not packaged. Racold sells the full heat stack: ETC/FPC SWH 100–500 LPD + Heat Pump Domestic 200–500L ₹1,99,999 (70% electricity save) — but there is no single "SWH + Heat Pump + electric backup" explainer PDF/EMI page to run as Meta lead ad in winter.
Why it matters: one bundle LP + 70% save math is the winter angle electric-only brands cannot copy.
